listen_address.description: IP address or hostname on which the Pushgateway listens for incoming metric pushes.

listen_port.description: Port number on which the Pushgateway listens for HTTP requests.

web_route_prefix.description: Path prefix under which all web UI and API endpoints are served (e.g., `/pushgateway/`).

persistence_file.description: Path to the file where pushed metrics are persisted (if persistence is enabled).

persisting.description: Whether to persist pushed metrics to disk across restarts.

persist_interval.description: Interval for persisting metrics to disk (e.g., `2m`, `30s`). Only applies if `persisting` is true.

max_connections.description: Maximum number of concurrent HTTP connections (including push, GET, and metrics requests).

web_timeout.description: Timeout for HTTP requests to backend (e.g., when using `-push` flag or when proxying to backend).

web_basic_auth_realm.description: Realm name used in HTTP Basic Auth challenge responses (if authentication is enabled).

static_labels.description: List of static labels to apply to all pushed metrics. Useful for adding environment/job metadata.

basic_auth_enabled.description: Enable HTTP Basic Authentication for push and web endpoints.

web_basic_auth_file.description: Path to the file containing HTTP Basic Auth credentials (format: `user:password_hash`). Only used if `basic_auth_enabled` is true.

tls_enabled.description: Enable TLS (HTTPS) for the web server.

web_config_file.description: Path to the TLS configuration file (cert, key, client CAs, etc.). Only used if `tls_enabled` is true.

metrics_enabled.description: Enable exposure of internal Pushgateway metrics (e.g., `pushgateway_http_requests_total`).

metrics_path.description: Path under which internal metrics are exposed (only relevant if `metrics_enabled` is true).

log_level.description: Verbosity of application logs. Set to 'debug' for detailed diagnostic output.
